description_en: Currently, this operation only revokes the team administrator role
description_zh: 当前仅支持取消团队管理员角色
kebab_example: aliyun pds cancel-assign-role --identity identity_id=16435bdf934248b788b7b3771ee9a3dw identity_type=IT_User --role-id SystemGroupAdmin --manage-resource-type RT_Group --manage-resource-id 105000b82 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelAssignRole

fields.help_en: The ID of the user or the group
fields.name: identity_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the identity. Valid values:

IT_User
IT_Group
fields.help_zh:
对象类型
IT_User：表示用户类型
IT_Group：表示群组类型
fields.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en: The identity whose role is to be revoked. Currently, this must be a user
parameters.help_zh: 唯一身份标识，当前仅支持取消用户的角色
parameters.name: identity

parameters.help_en: The ID of the managed resource. This must be a Group ID
parameters.help_zh: 被取消角色管理的资源ID，当前仅支持填Group ID
parameters.name: manage_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type of the managed resource. This must be set to `RT_Group` (team)
parameters.help_zh: 被取消角色管理的资源类型，当前仅支持：RT_Group（团队）
parameters.name: manage_resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the role to revoke. This must be set to `SystemGroupAdmin` (team administrator)
parameters.help_zh: 取消用户已分配的角色ID，当前仅支持填：SystemGroupAdmin（团队管理员）
parameters.name: role_id

v1_parameters.help_en: A short description of the struct
v1_parameters.name: domain_id
